body.statement: Under the population dictionary, training measurability, conditional square-integrability, and bridge-rate conditions, the explicitly constructed fold dictionaries satisfy \[\max_k\|\widehat D_{J_n}^{(-k)}-D^0_{J_n}\|_{L^2(P)}=O_p(\delta_{D,n}),\qquad \delta_{D,n}=O_p\{B_{J_n}(e_{h,4,n}+e_{q,4,n})+e_{h,4,n}e_{q,4,n}\}.\] Conditional on \(\mathcal D_{-k}\), training/holdout independence and the fourth-moment growth condition give \(\eta_{G,n}=O_p\{J_nB_{J_n}^2\sqrt{\log(1+J_n)/n}+\sqrt{J_n}B_{J_n}\delta_{D,n}+J_n\delta_{D,n}^2\}\) and \(\eta_{c,n}=O_p\{\sqrt{J_n}B_{J_n}^2\sqrt{\log(1+J_n)/n}+\sqrt{J_n}B_{J_n}\delta_{D,n}\}\). The positive ridge makes every fold coefficient unique, and resolvent perturbation gives \[\max_k\|\widehat b^{(-k)\top}\widehat D_{J_n}^{(-k)}-\Pi_{\mathcal C_P}\phi_0\|_2=O_p\!\left(\alpha_{J_n}+L_n\delta_{D,n}+\frac{\eta_{G,n}+\eta_{c,n}}{\kappa_{J_n}}+b_{\rho,n}\right)=o_p(1).\] The explicit deterministic coefficient-to-weight identity then yields \(\|\widehat\psi-\theta(P)-\phi_{\mathrm{eff}}\|_2=o_p(1)\); this convergence is derived rather than assumed.
body.justification: The lemma closes the feasible-projection step from primitive bridge, sieve, and empirical-moment rates rather than assuming the desired efficient signal.
body.gap: AiChen2012SequentialMoments controls optimally weighted sieve moments and BennettEtAl2023SourceConditionDR controls one primal-dual score; neither derives an affine four-corner dictionary projection with learned nonunique bridge representatives.
body.consumer: The lemma supplies checkable tuning and rate diagnostics for the SUPPORT affine-ensemble implementation.

obligation.what_is_open: Derivation of the claimed learned-dictionary norm, logarithmic empirical Gram and cross-moment rates, and stable ridge prediction from the stated primitive rate and moment assumptions.
obligation.obstruction: The current assumptions give population-coordinate fourth moments and separate learner L4 errors, but no product envelope for multiplying errors by population bridges or residuals, no conditional tail condition for the learned growing dictionary, and no dimension factor in the asserted Euclidean vector rate. They therefore do not imply the displayed rates.
obligation.attempted: Expanded every pure and four-corner learned signal, applied Holder and conditional cross-fitting bounds, and checked the resolvent equation. These steps expose missing factor-product moments, growing-vector factors, and coefficient-times-Gram perturbation terms rather than the claimed bound.
obligation.partial_result:
For any population bridge cell \((h^0,q^0)\) and its training-fold estimates, conditioning on the training sample gives the exact mixed-bias identity
\[
 E\{S_a(\widehat h,\widehat q)-S_a(h^0,q^0)\mid\mathcal D_{-k}\}
 =-E[I_a(\widehat q-q^0)(\widehat h-h^0)\mid\mathcal D_{-k}],
\]
and hence
\[
 \left|E\{S_a(\widehat h,\widehat q)-S_a(h^0,q^0)\mid\mathcal D_{-k}\}\right|
 \leq\min\{\|T_a(\widehat h-h^0)\|_2\|\widehat q-q^0\|_2,
 \|T_a^*(\widehat q-q^0)\|_2\|\widehat h-h^0\|_2\}.
\]
After affine weighting this is \(O_p(L_n\min\{r_{h,n}e_{q,2,n},r_{q,n}e_{h,2,n}\})\).  The frozen assumptions do not, however, imply the asserted learned-vector dictionary norm or its logarithmic Gram rate: separate bridge \(L^4\) errors do not control multiplication by an unbounded population bridge or outcome residual, coordinatewise control incurs dimension factors in Euclidean vector norm, and fourth moments alone do not yield the displayed logarithmic operator-norm concentration for a growing learned dictionary.
